title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Conveyancing Paralegal

Location: Edinburgh
Salary: Competitive + Benefits
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About the Role

Reed are currently recruiting for an experienced Conveyancing Paralegal to join a well-established and growing firm in Edinburgh. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented professional to take ownership of a varied residential conveyancing caseload while working alongside experienced solicitors in a supportive and collaborative environment.

The successful candidate will play a key role in managing conveyancing transactions from instruction through to completion, ensuring clients receive a professional and efficient service throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage a caseload of residential conveyancing transactions, including sales, purchases, transfers of title and remortgages.
- Draft and review legal documentation and correspondence.
- Liaise with clients, solicitors, lenders, estate agents and other third parties.
- Conduct property searches and review title deeds and reports.
- Prepare settlement statements and completion documentation.
- Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, regulatory requirements and internal procedures.
- Provide exceptional client service and maintain accurate case records.

About You
- Previous experience working as a Conveyancing Paralegal within a Scottish legal practice.
- Strong understanding of the residential conveyancing process in Scotland.
- Ability to manage a busy caseload with minimal supervision.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Strong communication and client relationship management skills.
- Proficiency in case management systems and Microsoft Office applications.
- Paralegal Accreditation qualification would be desirable but not essential.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Hybrid working opportunities.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.
- Career development and progression opportunities.
- Exposure to a diverse range of residential property transactions.

How to Apply

If this is of interest, please apply with an up to date copy of your CV or contact Zoe King at Reed for more information.

title: Legal PA
description:
Legal PA
Edinburgh
9-Month FTC

I'm working with a well-established commercial law firm in Edinburgh that is looking to bring an experienced Legal PA into its team on an initial 9-month fixed-term contract. I am particularly interested in speaking with PA's that have a background in the Commerical Property area.

This is a really good opportunity for someone who enjoys a varied PA role and wants to join a friendly, supportive environment where you'll be trusted to use your initiative and manage your own workload.
You'll be supporting lawyers across commercial practice areas, with a mix of PA, matter management and financial administration responsibilities.

The role will include:
- Client and matter onboarding, including AML processes.
- Billing, ledger management and financial administration.
- Preparing, formatting and amending legal documents.
- Diary and general administrative support.
- Using document and practice management systems.
- Supporting the wider team during busy periods, holidays and absence.
- Keeping matters organised and ensuring deadlines and processes are kept on track.

You'll ideally have previous experience as a Legal PA or Legal Secretary within a law firm, although the specific practice area is less important than having strong PA fundamentals.

Commercial Property experience would be particularly useful, but it isn't essential.

You'll also need:
- Strong Microsoft Word skills, including formatting, automatic numbering and cross-referencing.
- Confidence dealing with billing, ledgers and numbers.
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail.
- Good systems knowledge and the confidence to pick up new technology quickly.
- A proactive approach and the ability to work independently.
- A flexible, team-focused attitude and willingness to muck in when required.

What's on offer
- 9-month FTC with potential for extension.
- Hybrid working with just 2 days per week in the Edinburgh office.
- Flexible approach around office days.
- Flexi-time arrangements.
- Friendly and collaborative working environment.
- Opportunity to gain exposure across different areas of commercial law.

If you're an experienced Legal PA or Legal Secretary and would be open to hearing more, please apply now.

title: Legal PA
description:
Legal PA - Finance

Edinburgh 12 Month Fixed-Term Contract

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Legal Personal Assistant to join a well-established international law firm in Edinburgh, providing support to a busy Finance team.

You will deliver high-quality, proactive PA support to a group of Partners and fee earners, with a focus on property finance work.

The Role

Responsibilities will include:
- Providing comprehensive PA and administrative support to Partners and fee earners.
- Managing complex diaries, meetings, travel arrangements and appointments.
- Assisting with client billing, financial reporting and general matter management.
- Supporting business development activities, including events, pitches and tenders.
- Assisting with client onboarding, conflict checks and due diligence processes.
- Coordinating meeting preparation, documentation and general team administration.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring administrative processes are completed efficiently.
- Working collaboratively with colleagues across the wider business to ensure a high standard of support.

About You
- Previous Legal PA experience is essential, ideally with at least two years' experience in a similar role.
- Experience supporting Partners and senior fee earners within a professional services environment.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and legal document management systems.
- A proactive, flexible and collaborative approach, with excellent attention to detail.
- A strong commitment to delivering exceptional client service.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established international law firm and become part of a supportive team, providing exposure to a varied and interesting workload.

If you're an experienced Legal PA seeking your next opportunity and are available for a 12-month fixed-term contract, I'd love to hear from you. Apply now or get in touch with Melissa Tang at G2 Legal, for a confidential discussion.

title: Legal PA - Corporate and Employment
description:
Legal PA Corporate & Employment
Edinburgh Hybrid Working Full Time

Are you an experienced Legal PA looking for a role where you can become a genuinely valued part of the team you support?

I'm working with a highly regarded Scottish law firm looking to appoint an experienced Legal PA to join their Edinburgh office, supporting three Partners across Corporate and Employment Law.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, responsibility and working closely with senior fee earners. You'll be right at the heart of two busy practice areas, helping Partners stay organised, keeping matters moving and delivering an excellent service to clients.

Why consider this opportunity? The variety of the role really stands out.

You'll gain exposure across both Corporate and Employment work, with responsibilities ranging from corporate documentation and Companies House forms through to preparing Employment Tribunal bundles.

Alongside the legal work, you'll have ownership across diary management, client onboarding, billing, WIP, aged debt and the day-to-day organisation of your Partners.

The firm offers a supportive and collaborative culture, hybrid working, ongoing development and mentoring, progression opportunities and a competitive benefits package.

Your role will include:
- Providing dedicated PA support to three Partners across Corporate and Employment
- Managing busy diaries, appointments, meetings and email correspondence
- Preparing and amending corporate documentation
- Drafting Companies House forms
- Collating and preparing Employment Tribunal bundles
- Managing client onboarding, conflict checks and compliance requirements
- Supporting monthly billing, WIP and aged debt management
- Producing documents and maintaining accurate files
- Handling calls from existing and prospective clients
- Providing digital dictation support
- Proactively supporting fee earners to improve workflow and efficiency

What are they looking for? Ideally, you'll already have experience as a Legal PA, PA, Legal Executive or in a similar professional support position.

You'll be organised, confident managing competing priorities and comfortable working closely with senior fee earners. Strong client-care skills and excellent attention to detail are essential, alongside confidence using Microsoft Word, Excel and Adobe.

Most importantly, they're looking for someone proactive, adaptable and switched-on, who wants to become a trusted part of the team rather than simply wait for tasks to land on their desk.

Interested? If you're an experienced Legal PA in Edinburgh and would like a role offering Partner-level exposure, varied Corporate and Employment work, hybrid working and genuine scope to develop, I'd be keen to speak with you for a confidential conversation.

Rob Wallis
Creideas Recruitment

title: Residential Property Legal Secretary - Edinburgh
description:
Legal Administrator - Residential Property - Edinburgh Location: Morningside, Edinburgh
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Job Type: Permanent Full Time (Part Time Considered)
Working Pattern: Flexible Working Available

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Legal Administrator / Conveyancing Administrator to join the busy Residential Property team of a highly regarded and well-established law firm based in Morningside, Edinburgh.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with previous residential conveyancing or legal secretarial experience who is looking to join a friendly, professional and supportive team.

Working alongside experienced solicitors and conveyancing professionals, you'll provide essential administrative support across a varied caseload of residential property sales, purchases, transfers of title and remortgages.

The firm offers a positive working environment, with full-time, part-time and flexible working arrangements considered.

The Role
- Providing comprehensive administrative and secretarial support to the Residential Conveyancing team.
- Drafting legal correspondence, letters and property-related documentation.
- Undertaking property searches with Local Authorities and the Land Register of Scotland.
- Preparing Land Registration and Land and Buildings Transaction Tax (LBTT) forms.
- Assisting with the preparation of fee notes and billing.
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties throughout property transactions.
- Supporting client onboarding, including identification checks and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) compliance.
- Maintaining accurate client files and ensuring documentation is processed efficiently.
- Providing general administrative assistance to ensure the smooth running of the department.

About You
- Previous experience as a Legal Administrator, Conveyancing Administrator, Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant within residential property.
- A good understanding of Scottish residential conveyancing procedures would be advantageous.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage a busy workload.
- Strong communication skills and a professional, client-focused approach.
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Confident IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- A proactive, reliable and enthusiastic team player.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
- Permanent position within an established and respected law firm.
- Full-time or part-time hours considered.
- Flexible working arrangements, including some flexibility around place of work.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Opportunity to develop your career within a busy and successful Residential Property department.

Interested? If you're an experienced Legal Administrator, Residential Conveyancing Secretary or Conveyancing Assistant looking for a new opportunity in Edinburgh, I'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or get in touch with Jill McCartney at QED Legal for a confidential discussion.
